title: Verify A/B test creation with two variations
steps: 1. Login to VWO. 2. Navigate to Campaign Editor. 3. Click 'Create New Test'. 4. Select A/B test type. 5. Add Variation A and Variation B. 6. Save the campaign.
expected: Campaign is created with two variations listed under the Variations tab, status set to Draft.

title: Verify campaign cannot be published without a goal
steps: 1. Create a new A/B test campaign. 2. Skip goal configuration. 3. Click Publish.
expected: An inline validation error is shown: 'Please select at least one goal before publishing.' Campaign remains in Draft.

title: Verify element edit is saved on variation
steps: 1. Open Visual Editor for Variation A. 2. Change button text from 'Buy Now' to 'Shop Now'. 3. Click Save.
expected: The change persists after reload and is reflected in the live preview pane.

title: Verify conversion rate calculation for a running test
steps: 1. Open a running campaign with recorded visits and conversions. 2. Open the Reports tab.
expected: Conversion rate = conversions / visitors for each variation, matches manual calculation to 2 decimal places.

title: Verify report export to CSV
steps: 1. Open Reports tab for a completed campaign. 2. Click Export > CSV.
expected: A CSV file downloads containing variation name, visitors, conversions, and conversion rate columns.

title: Verify URL targeting rule with 'contains' condition
steps: 1. Create a new campaign. 2. Add URL targeting condition 'contains /checkout'. 3. Save and preview on a checkout page.
expected: The campaign triggers only on URLs containing '/checkout' and does not trigger on other pages.

title: Verify audience targeting by device type
steps: 1. Create a campaign. 2. Set audience condition Device = Mobile. 3. Preview on desktop and mobile emulators.
expected: Campaign only renders on mobile emulator; desktop preview shows original page.

title: Verify personalization campaign shows different content per segment
steps: 1. Create a Personalize campaign with two audience segments. 2. Assign different hero banners per segment. 3. Preview each segment.
expected: Each segment renders its assigned hero banner; no cross-segment leakage.

title: Verify Google Analytics integration sends VWO experiment data
steps: 1. Enable GA integration in account settings. 2. Run a campaign for 24 hours. 3. Check GA custom dimensions report.
expected: GA report shows the experiment ID and variation ID as custom dimensions on pageview hits.

title: Verify integration fails gracefully with invalid GA tracking ID
steps: 1. Enter an invalid GA tracking ID format. 2. Click Save.
expected: Inline error: 'Invalid tracking ID format.' Integration is not enabled and no requests are sent to GA.

title: Verify new team member invite via email
steps: 1. Go to Account Settings > Team. 2. Click Invite Member. 3. Enter email and select role 'Editor'. 4. Send invite.
expected: Invitee receives an email with an activation link; pending invite appears in the Team list with role Editor.

title: Verify role permissions restrict publish access for Viewer role
steps: 1. Log in as a user with Viewer role. 2. Open a campaign. 3. Attempt to click Publish.
expected: Publish button is disabled/hidden for Viewer role; tooltip explains insufficient permissions.

title: Verify multi-variant test supports up to 8 variations
steps: 1. Create a new MVT campaign. 2. Add variations until 8 total exist. 3. Attempt to add a 9th.
expected: App allows exactly 8 variations and shows 'Maximum of 8 variations reached' when attempting a 9th.

title: Verify statistical significance indicator updates live
steps: 1. Open Reports tab for a running test with traffic flowing. 2. Wait for at least 100 conversions per variation.
expected: Significance badge changes from 'Not significant' to 'Significant' once the 95% confidence threshold is crossed.

title: Verify undo/redo in Visual Editor
steps: 1. Make 3 sequential edits in Visual Editor. 2. Click Undo twice. 3. Click Redo once.
expected: After 2 undos the first edit remains; after 1 redo the second edit is reapplied; DOM state matches history stack.
